question: Why is there no question about the state of the fully established knowers at death?
premises: Some yogins are made of well-practiced knowledge and are always of the nature of Shiva.
Such yogins are liberated while living.
For them there is no deliberation or question at the time of death.
inference: Those already established in living liberation undergo no change in status at death.
plain_english: But those whose nature is well-practiced knowledge, who are always of the nature of Shiva, are indeed liberated while living; for them there is no question at all at the time of death.
